description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Categories," and lists the domains Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, with labels oriented diagonally and arranged in an unordered sequence rather than alphabetically or by value. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Sentences (K)" to indicate units in thousands, utilizing a linear scale with tick marks starting at 0 and continuing up to 800 at regular intervals of 200. Each category is represented by a single, solid light red vertical bar. Every bar is visually emphasized by a dark blue numerical annotation placed directly above it to indicate its exact value. From left to right, the bars correspond to Administrative (525), Religion (50), Non-fiction (190), Fiction (35), Law (23), News (902), Science (110), and Blogs (2). The tallest bar in the chart represents the News category with a value of 902, while the shortest bar corresponds to the Blogs category with a value of 2.
